notes_for_editor: Pre-1891 Light-House Board reports are not in the local corpus, so the 1839-40, 1858 and 1871 construction details rest on Lighthousefriends (copyrighted; paraphrased) and the NRHP nomination. Disagreements stated in the text: 1839 vs 1840 first light; fourth-order lens at first light (NPS) vs 1857 (Lighthousefriends); tower 100 vs 104 ft; focal plane 100 vs 104 ft. USLHS says automated 1935 but lists head keepers to 1958. The 1917/1918 duck report: Bulletin 1918 date year is garbled in OCR; year per Lighthousefriends. The Commissioner's 1922 Violet entry is undated within the report year. Roster lines (80) copied from USLHS archive; the 'person' slugs come from roster.py. The Tribune dispatch OCR errors are reproduced in the quote with [sic]. Jack Sheridan (2009) named only as published. Related life-saving station has its own record (us-mi-south-manitou-island-lighthouse-complex-and-life-saving-station).
